title: Minimax Rates and Spectral Distillation for Tree Ensembles
abstract: arXiv:2605.11841v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Tree ensembles such as random forests (RFs) and gradient boosting machines (GBMs) are among the most widely used supervised learners, yet their theoretical properties remain incompletely understood. We adopt a spectral perspective on these algorithms, with two main contributions. First, we derive minimax-optimal convergence for RF regression, showing that, under mild regularity conditions on tree growth, the eigenvalue decay of the induced kernel operator governs the statistical rate. Second, we exploit this spectral viewpoint to develop compression schemes for tree ensembles. For RFs, leading eigenfunctions of the kernel operator capture the dominant predictive directions; for GBMs, leading singular vectors of the smoother matrix play an analogous role. Learning nonlinear maps for these spectral representations yields distilled models that are orders of magnitude smaller than the originals while maintaining competitive predict

translated_title: 树集成模型的极小化极大速率与谱蒸馏
translated_abstract: 树集成模型，如随机森林（RF）和梯度提升机（GBM），是最广泛使用的监督学习方法之一，但其理论性质仍未被完全理解。我们对这些算法采用谱视角进行分析，包含两个主要贡献。首先，我们推导了随机森林回归的极小化极大最优收敛性，证明在树生长的温和正则性条件下，诱导核算子的特征值衰减决定了统计收敛速率。其次，我们利用这一谱视角为树集成模型开发了压缩方案。对于随机森林，核算子的主特征函数能够捕捉主导的预测方向；对于梯度提升机，平滑矩阵的主奇异向量则起到类似的作用。通过为这些谱表示学习非线性映射，可以得到比原始模型小数个数量级、同时保持有竞争力的预测性能的蒸馏模型。
tldr: 本文从谱理论视角研究随机森林与梯度提升机，证明了随机森林回归的极小化极大最优收敛速率（由核算子特征值衰减决定），并利用主特征函数和主奇异向量开发出体积缩小数个数量级且预测性能仍具竞争力的树集成模型蒸馏压缩方法。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes minimax-optimal convergence rates for random forest regression through spectral analysis and develops spectral distillation schemes that compress tree ensembles to a fraction of their original size while maintaining competitive predictive performance.
